# DeskMind

> DeskMind (DeskMind 得心) is open-source computer use for macOS. Small local models see the screen (Eyes), decide each step as a multiple-choice question with a probability for every option (Brain, served over the `/v1/systemone` API), and act on the desktop (Hands). A Mac app packages the loop; Bench measures it on a real desktop. When a task could mean two things, it asks instead of guessing.

- Release: Brain G18b, a 0.8B → 4B router (threshold 0.96) running locally with MLX on Apple Silicon. Real-desktop bench v25: 39/39 runs, no false "done" (13 tasks × 3, one M4 Pro). Decision time about 0.5 s (0.8B) / 3.6 s (4B).
- Licences: code Apache-2.0; docs CC BY 4.0; model weights, base models and datasets follow their own terms.
